to_nfold.name: Increase rotational symmetry, e.g. pentagonal prism to hexagonal prism
Decrease rotational symmetry, e.g. pentagonal prism to triangular prism
Change rotational symmetry with a fraction, the denominator introduces a step, e.g. pentagonal prism to {7/2}-prism
Change the basic step of a model, e.g. pentagramic dipyramid to pentagonal pyramid (2*3 = 1 mod(5))
Open an edge, taken as a digon, e.g. convert snub disphenoid to (non-Johnson) snub square antiprism
Close a polygon down to a digon, e.g. convert snub square antiprism to (non-Johnson) snub disphenoid
A 5/2 crossed-antiprism has oblique faces that cycle the axis, and the result of regular — to_nfold 7 ant5/3
A 5/2 crossed-antiprism has oblique faces that cycle the axis, and the result of regular — to_nfold 7 ant5/3 -x 0
Uncross a crossed-antiprism (the fraction parameter is required, but not used)
Dimple a ring of vertices of a snub-antiprism (the fraction parameter is required, but not used)
